## StreamDek Mobile v2.0.1

This release covers a broad set of fixes and new features across theming, live TV playback, playback engines, settings, add-ons, guest-account migration, and two new source/offline capabilities: M3U playlists and downloads.

### What's New

- **Live TV channel switching no longer blacks out the screen.** The channel you're already watching keeps decoding and playing (video and audio) the whole time the new one is resolved and prepared in the background - the switch happens on the same decoder in place once the new channel is ready, so there's nothing to cut away from. While it's loading, you'll see the current channel dimmed under a dark tint with the "switching…" message, not a black screen.
- **Live channels now tell you when they're just slow, not broken.** If a channel connects but is taking a while to start, StreamDek now says so instead of showing a generic spinner that looks identical to a stuck stream.
- **A channel no longer reloads a few seconds after it has already started.** Live streams are excluded from the transient audio/video metadata heuristic that could falsely switch player engines 3.5 seconds after a successful start; real player errors and stalls still trigger recovery.
- **You can now switch player engine mid-playback.** A new "Engine" control in the player lets you pick ExoPlayer or mpv on the fly, keeping your playback position. For on-demand streams, StreamDek can also detect video-with-no-audio or audio-with-no-video playback and try the other engine.
- **"Follow System" appearance actually follows the system now.** Fixed a bug where the app's language-context setup was unintentionally pinning the day/night theme at launch, so it never picked up later system theme changes.
- **Profile deletion no longer fails with a Bad Request.**
- **Guest users are offered a one-tap migration into their new account.** If you used StreamDek without an account and then register, StreamDek now offers to move your watchlist, favourites, continue-watching progress, and locally-added add-ons into the new account.
- **Add-ons can be reordered by long-press-and-drag** on the add-on logo, with a one-time hint the first time you visit the Add-ons screen.
- **CNC/local add-on detail pages load faster** - metadata lookups now run in parallel instead of one after another, and JS-based scraper add-ons reuse a cached, precompiled script instead of recompiling on every request.
- **Live TV favourites drawer is 10% wider** and now has a text/card view toggle and a "Clear all" action right at the top, instead of only in Settings.
- **Swipe-up-for-channels hint now points up**, matching the gesture it's hinting at.
- **App updates now show progress right in the floating nav bar** - tapping Update turns the nav into a download indicator (auto-expanding it first, if collapsible navigation is on) until the install is ready.
- **Settings reorganized**: the Services section (Add-ons, Plugins, Premium Services, Trakt, Connect to TV) now sits below Preferences, and Downloads has its own section directly below Services instead of being buried in General.
- **The player's Audio panel is now sized to its content** instead of always taking up most of the screen height.
- **Playback controls (rewind/play/forward) no longer get squashed on smaller screens** - they now keep a fixed size and spacing on every device instead of compressing to fit a width-based layout.
- **Pulling down to reveal Settings search no longer also triggers a refresh** - the two gestures are now handled independently, so a light pull only reveals search and a deliberate longer pull is what refreshes.
- **New: M3U/IPTV playlist support.** Add a playlist URL from Settings › M3U Playlists; its channels show up as a Home row and play through the existing Live TV pipeline, right alongside favourites and other channel sources.
- **Very large IPTV playlists remain responsive.** Playlist and non-playlist live cards no longer scan the complete M3U list on the UI thread. Home shows a bounded preview, while View All supports the complete list with local search and Playlist order, A–Z, and Z–A sorting. This was device-tested with 84,704 channels.
- **New: optional downloads for offline playback.** Turn on "Allow Downloads" in Settings, then download eligible movie/episode sources (progressive or HLS, played through the Media3 engine) - from the download icon on a source's card in the player's Sources list, or by long-pressing a stream on a title's detail page. Manage, track progress, play back offline, and remove downloads from Settings › Downloads. Off by default; live channels and torrent-only sources aren't downloadable.
- Add-on manifest input placeholder now reads "Paste add-on manifest link".
- Playback settings now show "Auto" instead of "Auto (recommended)" for the default player engine.

### Notes

- Usenet/NZB support was scoped out of this release - it needs its own backend project (indexer search, NNTP retrieval, PAR2 repair/unpacking) that doesn't exist yet, unlike M3U playlists which play directly.
